records.issue_text: Controller specs for add_members/remove_member inject group_id directly into the params hash instead of going through real route/URL parsing, masking the routing/param-name mismatch and letting broken tests pass
records.rationale: The diff shows routes `delete "members" => "groups#remove_member"` and `put "members" => "groups#add_members"` nested under `resources :groups`, which yields the `group_id` param the controllers use (`params.require(:group_id)`). The controller specs use `xhr :put, :add_members, group_id: group.id, ...`, matching the actual param name — no routing/param mismatch exists in the diff to be masked. The claim of a mismatch is speculative and describes standard controller-spec practice as a defect; it is not a verifiable bug introduced by this change.

records.issue_text: limit param in groups_controller members action is read from client input with no upper bound, allowing unbounded query size
records.rationale: The diff introduces `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` in groups_controller#members, applied directly to `members.limit(limit).offset(offset)` with no upper bound, so a client can request an arbitrarily large limit. Previous code defaulted automatic groups to 200. This is an unbounded query size / DoS concern introduced by the diff, and is verifiable from the shown code.
